Container.Name: elibosley Unraid apps
Container.Profile: [b]elibosley's Unraid Community Applications repository[/b][br][br] Plugins and drivers for Unraid.[br][br] Currently included:[br] - [b]RTL88xxAU USB WiFi Driver (rtw88)[/b] - in-kernel mac80211 driver for Realtek RTL8811AU / RTL8821AU / RTL8812AU / RTL8814AU USB Wi-Fi adapters that Unraid ships disabled. Supports WPA3-SAE; rebuilt automatically per Unraid kernel.
